preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' if m % 2 != 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the number of edges is odd, output 'No solution'.

postconditions.expression: len(paths) == m // 2 and all(len(path) == 3 for path in paths)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output m // 2 paths, each consisting of three vertices.

postconditions.expression: all((path[0], path[1]) in edges and (path[1], path[2]) in edges for path in paths)
postconditions.description: Each path must consist of edges that exist in the graph.
